ariaLabelX.comment: Aria-label for the locale filter button. { text } is the current filter display text (e.g. 'All' or a locale code)
ariaLabelX.fr-ca: Filtrer les paramètres régionaux. Affichage actuel : {text}
ariaLabelX.ru: Фильтр по языкам. В данный момент отображается: {text}
ariaLabelX.ja: 地域をフィルタリングします。現在表示中: {text}

allLocales.comment: Locale filter trigger text shown when every locale is selected (or none is selected)

localesCountX.comment: Locale filter trigger text when several (but not all) locales are selected. {count} is the number of selected locales.
localesCountX.fr-ca: { count, plural, =1 {1 paramètre régional} other {{count} paramètres régionaux} }
localesCountX.ru: { count, plural, one {{count} язык} few {{count} языка} many {{count} языков} other {{count} языка} }
localesCountX.ja: { count, plural, other {{count} 件の地域} }
